description: This Java class 'RomeEventHandler' handles web events related to RSS feed generation within the OFBiz framework. It initializes a feed service, creates links, and outputs RSS feeds using Rome library classes.

classes.name: RomeEventHandler
classes.description: A class that handles web events to generate and output RSS feeds using Rome library within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler, setting up the service handler and output formatter.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles the event to generate RSS feed, creates links, invokes feed service, and writes the RSS output to response.
